about1: Travel through the world of watercolor with Dusan, experience
about2: and discover the secret of the beauty of watercolor art.
info: Join us for the solo exhibition of Dusan Djukaric - Singidunum Gallery in Belgrade. August 14 - September 02, 2023.
payPal: All paintings can be paid for using PayPal.
artistText1: Born in 1971, he studied at the Academy of Arts in Belgrade. A member of ULUPUDS, with the status of an independent artist. In addition to Serbia, Dušan has exhibited and had very significant solo and group exhibitions in Switzerland, France, China, Italy, Spain, Great Britain, Taiwan, Austria, Pakistan, etc.
artistText2: He was invited as a judge several times in Turkey, at the International Watercolorists Competition. He has won numerous awards for his work. His artworks have been selected and featured in a large number of catalogs within the International Watercolor Association.
artistText3: Furthermore, his achievements have secured him a place in the encyclopedic edition “Successful People of Serbia”, published by OXFORD WORLDWIDE PRESS, thereby confirming his status among the distinguished 3000 individuals included in the edition.
artistText4: His thoughts, interviews, on watercolor and art have been published in prestigious international magazines such as “Pratique des Arts” (issues 109 and 114) and “The Art of Watercolour” (issue 21).
artistText5: As well as numerous online publications, a significant number of interviews in national magazines, and TV interviews, interviews in magazines such as Pečat, Lider, Nacionalna Revija, Blic, Dan, Večernje novosti, etc.
artistText6: His works are owned by numerous collectors around the world, as well as in private collections of art enthusiasts and admirers...
artistText7: He lives and works in Belgrade, traveling, painting, and presenting his works globally as a respected master of watercolor.
watercolorText2: If success is achieved by harnessing that insight, you understand that watercolor is never entirely graspable. It is always a few steps ahead of you, and it can always be reimagined right before the goal... And for that failure, you always know the reason, which is uncontrollable chance.
watercolorText3: Uncontrolled chance must be controlled, and that's the job and perseverance of learning, believing in oneself, having self-confidence that you can do it. Watercolor must become your ally, having tractability and the desire to whisper to you the way to achieve it.
watercolorText5: There is no inspiration that comes on its own, but the daily effort in painting can replace every inspiration. Inspiration is not what you wait for to appear, inspiration is what you learn.
watercolorText7: By working every day even when there are no results. Only by work can you beat failure and have results. In this way the artist makes inspiration cooperate with him. Inspiration is the result, not the cause of success. It is very frustrating to have inspiration and no results. I almost never managed to make something great with ease without first investing in my own confidence, without believing that I could do that.
shopingText: Ready to find your next favorite watercolor? Don't hesitate, start exploring our stunning gallery now!
pressText1: A watercolour is a painting that reveals an artist who performs a play before the audience, and that play has to have everything - a good script, direction, stage, lighting and in the end you get an extra round of applause... If these are absent, you will play without a prize.
pressText2: A good watercolor reveals everything from the first to the last move, everything is presented to the observer to judge. That is the privilege of an artist, to fully reveal himself to other and to remain unhurt. That is watercolor...
pressText3: Fascinated by the notion of instant, this Serbian watercolorist, who devotes a true passion to painting en plein air, reveals here landscapes bathed in a soft and diffused light. The eye can travel around and wander, this is where experience is important and precious and comes into rescue when it is necessary...
pressText4: Dusan Djukaric is fascinated by the notion of the moment: the one when he paints and the one he portrays in his atmospheric landscapes, preferably Mediterranean, bathed in a soft and diffused light.
pressText4.2: 'Where should one stop, where is the limit? I am always experimenting.'
pressText5: He elevated this art to a higher level. We don't recognize his urban settings by their accuracy of description, but by the impression they leave. He is a painter of atmosphere, not a mere replicator of reality.
pressText5.2: 'In his works, he brings serenity and a sense of space.'
